name: Cisco MCP Pods Server
description: Enables AI agents to interact with Cisco API Gateway pods endpoints for complete pod management including CRUD operations, credential updates, and configuration management through natural language. Supports multiple deployment modes including local Claude Desktop integration and cloud deployment for remote AI agents like Webex Connect.
